delivery_binding.claim_ceiling: Successful request receipt binds visible read bytes; source validation, final selection and semantic use require separate evidence. Archives, tokenizer-only captures and unsuccessful dispatches are not confirmed delivery.

- Fix hydration regression with `{@html}` and components in `<svelte:head>` ([#7941](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/7941))

- Fix hydration with `{@html}` and components in `<svelte:head>` ([#4533](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/4533), [#6463](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/6463), [#7444](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/7444))

- Fix placement of `{@html}` when used at the root of a slot, at the root of a component, or in `<svelte:head>` ([#5012](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/5012), [#5071](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/5071))

- [7ty](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jamcart/7ty) is a static site generator that uses Svelte, supports partial hydration of components, and uses file based routing resembling Sapper and 11ty.
- Svelte 3.38.1 and 3.38.2 fixed an issue with hydration that was causing duplicate elements. If you're seeing this in your project, be sure to update the latest version!

- [Svelte 3.38.3](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#3383) (released June 22) includes a bunch of performance and bug fixes - including hydration optimizations, `this` preservation in bubbled events, and more!

- [Web Rush](https://webrush.io/episodes/episode-153-single-page-application-vs-multi-page-application-with-rich-harris) and Rich Harris talk about the differences between a SPA and MPA, what role the server rendering plays, what client side hydration is, and the state of modern tooling for developing an SPA or MPA
- [SvelteKit + `<is-land>`](https://sveltekit-is-land.vercel.app/) is an experiment with partial hydration in SvelteKit using `@11ty/is-land`
- A warning will now indicated that hydration may break if comments are removed from HTML (**1.0.11**, [#8423](https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/pull/8423))

This release results in smaller and faster hydration code. To see the impact, SvelteKit users can see their compiled output shrink in size by examining the `.svelte-kit/output/client/_app/immutable/nodes` folder. For example, on [kit.svelte.dev](https://kit.svelte.dev) the JS generated across the whole site was reduced in size by 12.7% (126.3 kB to 110.2 kB).

selection.summary: Task: chore PR documenting the @html and hydration change (closes #12333) plus a test. Relevant delivered base evidence: hydration machinery (packages/svelte/src/internal/client/dom/hydration.js h2) and the @html block client code (dom/blocks/html.js h15) where the behavior is implemented/should be documented; attribute handling where hydration/select_value edge cases live (dom/elements/attributes.js h19); dev-mode warning context (internal/server/dev.js h7, client/warnings.js h17). Test-side anchors: hydration test harness (tests/hydration/test.ts h10, html_equal.js h13) and existing sample tests covering raw/html-tag hydration mismatch and repair (html-tag-hydration-2 h5/h18, raw-mismatch h14, raw-repair h22, element-attribute-unchanged-2 h20) as templates for the new test asserting the @html / hydration mismatch behavior. Blog/CHANGELOG handles were not relevant.

selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
